consequences: No LLM call or automatic semantic consolidation is introduced. Full ANN/graph/LLM consolidation and tokenizer-specific calibration remain separate. Pausing periodic maintenance does not disable explicit Forget, privacy or extraction governance.
context: A03 merged evidence without enhancing content; A04 tiny budgets clipped accounting; default lifecycle had no periodic scheduler.
decision: Governed MERGE enhances gist/tags/importance while preserving privacy, validating sources and base content fingerprint, and rejecting conflicting rollback. Budget uses actual returned text under a named heuristic; undersized budgets omit items. MemorySystem manages an hourly bounded least-recently-scored lifecycle worker with atomic retention/heat/tombstone checkpoint and persisted confirmed pause controls.
title: Memory semantic merge budget and maintenance v1
